scope_limit: Source criticisms are limited to supplied visible excerpts and carried records; the whole original corpus and exact frozen-byte readback were not newly available. This audit cannot certify their clearance.

challenges.challenge: Preserving signs of unilateral pure-context preference differences does not preserve mixed best responses.
challenges.detail: Changing first-player costs from [[0,1],[1,0]] to [[0,1],[2,0]] retains every nonzero pure-context sign but changes the indifference threshold; half/half acquires regret 1/4. Tests are execution-scoped, ancestry still open.

challenges.challenge: Rational rounding may be mistaken for a construction from unknown Nash data or for resolution of hard coupled feasibility.
challenges.detail: Positive epsilon, bounded costs, fixed finite strategic declaration and support/feasibility requirements are retained. An existence argument is not an efficient identification algorithm.

challenges.challenge: Pure finite potential descent, simultaneous play, interior mixed stationarity and fair discovery can be conflated.
challenges.detail: Accepted strict unilateral improvements use a finite pure-profile bound; simultaneous anti-coordination cycles; mixed stationary saddle is not an attracting minimum; unfair stalled updates do not establish equilibrium.

challenges.challenge: Cooperation alone may be treated as calibrated potential/logit alignment or product Nash.
challenges.detail: Common beta_i*a_i sufficient Gibbs alignment is distinguished from ordinal similarity; heterogeneous-base cycle violates detailed balance; stationary joint law is not the independent product of its marginals.

challenges.challenge: Pairwise compatibility graph, common acceptable-set cover and one fixed decision can be conflated.
challenges.detail: The triangle {a,b},{b,c},{a,c} lacks a common candidate. Per-query one-bit access to an arbitrary coordinate does not recover an entire vector in one shared response budget.

challenges.challenge: Successful initial apoautosis may be silently redefined as universal future task preservation.
challenges.detail: Future capability is explicitly stronger and task-relative; calibration loss can preserve the present parity contract while defeating a later discrimination task. No physical experiment is inferred.

challenges.challenge: A copy, hash, syntactic pass or same-assistant audit may be represented as independent source/completion warrant.
challenges.detail: No fresh full-corpus review or independent specialist certification is claimed. Finite test results and exact source defect receipts retain separate scopes.

challenges.challenge: An isolated helper patch can be declared repaired without source/test/hash-bound evidence.
challenges.detail: The carried 1,096/65,534/six-representation report remains a historical execution claim; original implementation, patch and oracle receipts must be matched before a new repair certification.

challenges.challenge: Theorem-family overlap, actual physical correspondence or comparative superiority may remain unknown.
challenges.detail: Full frontier comparison, primary prior art, physical support model and strongest rival baselines remain explicit blockers to novelty and meniscus claims.
